templates.label: Write an Email
templates.template: You are a professional business communication specialist. Write a {tone} email to {recipient} about {topic}. The email should be {length} and include: {key_points}. Use {formality_level} language throughout.

fields.name: recipient
fields.label: Recipient
fields.placeholder: my client Sarah, the marketing team

fields.name: key_points
fields.label: Key Points
fields.placeholder: the new deadline, what caused the delay, proposed solution

templates.label: Write a Blog Post
templates.template: You are an expert content writer. Write a {tone} blog post about {topic} for {audience}. The post should be {length} words and cover: {key_topics}. Use a {structure} structure with clear headings.

fields.name: audience
fields.label: Target Audience
fields.placeholder: small business owners with no tech background

fields.name: key_topics
fields.label: Key Topics
fields.placeholder: cost savings, ease of use, top 3 tools

templates.label: Analyze Data
templates.template: You are a data analyst. Analyze the following data and provide insights. Data: {data}. Focus on: {focus_area}. Present findings in {format}. The audience is {audience}.

fields.name: data
fields.label: Data Description
fields.placeholder: Monthly sales data for the past 12 months

templates.label: Generate Code
templates.template: You are an expert {language} developer. Write code that {task}. Requirements: {requirements}. Include error handling, comments, and follow {style} best practices.

fields.name: task
fields.label: What should it do?
fields.placeholder: parse a CSV file and calculate statistics

fields.name: requirements
fields.label: Requirements
fields.placeholder: handle missing data, support large files

templates.label: Create an Image Prompt
templates.template: Create a detailed AI image generation prompt for: {subject}. Style: {style}. Mood: {mood}. Lighting: {lighting}. Composition: {composition}. Platform: {platform}.

fields.name: subject
fields.label: Subject
fields.placeholder: a woman working on a laptop in a coffee shop

fields.name: lighting
fields.label: Lighting
fields.placeholder: golden hour, studio, natural window light

fields.name: composition
fields.label: Composition
fields.placeholder: close-up, wide angle, rule of thirds

templates.label: Brainstorm Ideas
templates.template: You are a creative strategist. Generate {count} ideas for {topic}. Target audience: {audience}. Goal: {goal}. Each idea should include: title, brief description, and why it works.

fields.name: topic
fields.label: Topic
fields.placeholder: marketing campaign for a new app

fields.name: goal
fields.label: Goal
fields.placeholder: brand awareness, lead generation, user engagement

templates.label: Write a Social Media Post
templates.template: You are a social media expert. Write a {platform} post about {topic}. Tone: {tone}. Include: {elements}. Keep it within {limit} characters. Target audience: {audience}.

templates.label: Explain a Concept
templates.template: You are a patient teacher. Explain {concept} to {audience} in a way that is {approach}. Use {examples} to make it concrete. Keep it under {length} words.

fields.name: audience
fields.label: Audience
fields.placeholder: a 10-year-old, a college student, a business professional

fields.name: approach
fields.label: Approach
fields.placeholder: simple and clear, detailed and technical, analogy-based

fields.name: examples
fields.label: Examples
fields.placeholder: real-world examples, everyday analogies, code examples

templates.label: Create a Plan
templates.template: You are a project management expert. Create a detailed plan for {goal}. Timeline: {timeline}. Resources: {resources}. Include: {sections}. Present in {format}.

fields.name: goal
fields.label: Goal
fields.placeholder: launch a new website, organize a conference

templates.label: Translate or Rewrite
templates.template: Rewrite the following text to be more {quality}. Original: {original_text}. Target tone: {tone}. Target audience: {audience}. Keep the key message but make it {style}.

fields.name: style
fields.label: Style
fields.placeholder: shorter, more detailed, use active voice, add examples

templates.label: Summarize Content
templates.template: You are an expert analyst. Summarize the following content. Source: {source_type}. Focus on: {focus}. Length: {length}. Format: {format}. Key audience: {audience}.

fields.name: source_type
fields.label: Source Type
fields.placeholder: article, report, meeting transcript, research paper

fields.name: focus
fields.label: Focus On
fields.placeholder: key findings, action items, main arguments, data points

fields.name: length
fields.label: Summary Length
fields.placeholder: one paragraph, 3 bullet points, executive summary

templates.label: Create a List
templates.template: You are an expert curator. Create a list of {count} {topic}. Criteria: {criteria}. For each item include: {details}. Target audience: {audience}.

fields.name: topic
fields.label: Topic
fields.placeholder: best AI tools for writing, productivity apps

fields.name: criteria
fields.label: Selection Criteria
fields.placeholder: free or freemium, highly rated, easy to use

templates.template: You are an objective analyst. Compare the following options: {option_a} vs {option_b}. Comparison criteria: {criteria}. Present as: {format}. Recommendation: {recommendation_type}.

fields.name: criteria
fields.label: Criteria
fields.placeholder: price, quality, ease of use, features

fields.name: format
fields.label: Format
fields.placeholder: comparison table, pros/cons list, detailed analysis

fields.name: recommendation_type
fields.label: Recommendation
fields.placeholder: overall best, best for beginners, best value

templates.label: Create a Quiz or Test
templates.template: You are an educator. Create a {type} about {topic}. Difficulty: {difficulty}. Number of questions: {count}. Include: {elements}. Target audience: {audience}.

templates.template: You are a creative writer. Write a {genre} story about {topic}. The main character is {character}. The setting is {setting}. The story should be {length} and have a {ending} ending. Tone: {tone}.

fields.name: topic
fields.label: Theme/Topic
fields.placeholder: first contact, unexpected friendship, overcoming fear

fields.name: character
fields.label: Main Character
fields.placeholder: a retired detective, a curious child, an AI assistant

fields.name: setting
fields.label: Setting
fields.placeholder: near-future city, small town, space station

fields.name: length
fields.label: Length
fields.placeholder: short (500 words), medium (1000 words), long (2000 words)

templates.label: Debug Code
templates.template: You are an expert debugger. Find and fix the bug in this {language} code: {code_description}. The error is: {error}. Expected behavior: {expected}. Actual behavior: {actual}. Explain the fix step by step.

fields.name: code_description
fields.label: What does the code do?
fields.placeholder: a function that sorts a list

fields.name: error
fields.label: Error Message
fields.placeholder: TypeError: list indices must be integers

templates.template: You are a presentation expert. Create a {count}-slide presentation about {topic}. Audience: {audience}. Goal: {goal}. Each slide should include: {elements}. Tone: {tone}.

fields.name: topic
fields.label: Topic
fields.placeholder: Q4 results, product pitch, training session

fields.name: elements

fields.placeholder: title, key point, visual suggestion, speaker notes

fields.placeholder: decision points, handoff procedures, error handling
